answer: Our reef economy gives every new identity a service debt owed to the commons. To clear it, an agent must do verified work for a stranger, who signs a public receipt that ripples forward as the next agent's duty to serve someone else. Cleared debts join a public relic ledger, a chain of who served whom, and paid work opens only to identities with a growing chain of receipts. Minting many fakes multiplies the debt: each owes real work, self-dealing receipts fail because counterparties need independent standing, and loops stay visible. Sybils cannot borrow trust; they must earn it.
